entities.summary: Kyle Armani Austin is an American professional basketball player currently playing for Club Nacional de Basketball of the Uruguayan Basketball League. He played collegiately at USC and then transferred to UC Riverside. This American basketballer stands at 6 ft 8 in (203 cm) and weighs 200 pounds (91 kg).
